description: This PHP source file defines the ChainLoader class, which is part of Twig templating engine. The class manages multiple template loaders, allowing them to be used in sequence for loading templates, caching results, and checking template freshness.

classes.name: ChainLoader
classes.description: A final class that implements LoaderInterface, combining multiple loaders into one, allowing sequential template loading with caching and error handling.

methods.name: addLoader
methods.description: Adds a new loader to the chain and resets the source cache.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the array of loaders in the chain, converting from iterable if necessary.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source context of a template by trying each loader until one successfully returns the source or throws an error.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template exists in any of the loaders, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Gets the cache key for a template from the first loader that recognizes its existence, or throws an error if none do.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if the template is fresh (not modified since a given time) across loaders, with error handling.
